versions.changelog: 默认返回最终采集结果，完善异步等待下载与安全恢复；修复空目标误执行、Quick Start、Token 配置和触发路由冲突，并补齐发布前自动化测试
新增能力路由与异步任务闭环，修复失效引用、Token 泄漏和 Skill 元数据兼容性
补全中文文档，更新目录结构

Initial release of "dataify-facebook-profile-by-url": collect Facebook personal profile data by URL via Dataify.

- Guides users through required and optional parameters before submitting a collection task.
- Supports submitting single or multiple Facebook personal profile URLs.
- Handles Dataify API TOKEN setup, checking for existing tokens and prompting to save for future use.
- Uses a stable Python script to submit tasks and returns task ID and status on success.
- Includes guardrails for URL validation, token handling, and troubleshooting common errors.
- Always directs users to view results on the Dataify dashboard after task creation.
